ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 14 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers a first order discount, yet 0 of 25 ads mention it. New buyers see no reason to act now, so the sale stalls. Put the discount in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

Your site answers how fast a custom order arrives and whether it ships worldwide, yet 0 of 28 ads mention shipping or delivery. Unanswered delivery questions stop people before they design anything. Lead one ad per product with the delivery answer.
Your homepage shows a $24 price, yet 0 of 28 ads mention price or cost. Shoppers scroll past without a cost to compare. Lead one ad with the $24 price beside what the same item costs elsewhere.
None of your 28 ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing concrete to trust before the click. Collect one real figure, such as your review count or orders shipped, and lead one ad with it.
